result: Alternating Oja’s algorithm (to find and follow negative curvature) with a fast solver for the remaining almost-convex safe zone, Natasha 2 finds (ε, δ)-approximate local minima with Õ(δ^{−5} + δ^{−1}ε^{−3}) stochastic gradients, i.e. Õ(ε^{−3.25}) for δ = ε^{1/4}, beating SGD’s ε^{−4}.
result_plain: Natasha 2: Oja negative-curvature steps + safe-zone variance reduction, Õ(ε^-3.25) for approximate local minima.
